sources.entry: Amazing Tic Tac Toe - Fun Tic Tac Toe game equipped with multiplayer (local and online) and leveled single player available on the App Store.

summary.one_liner: A macOS Swift/Cocoa Tic-Tac-Toe game offering several modes, leveled bots, local multiplayer, and online multiplayer.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a simple Tic Tac Toe game built as a MacOSX Swift Cocoa app. It says the game includes several different modes, leveled computer bots, local multiplayer for players sharing one machine, and global (online) multiplayer. The README is very short and does not document setup steps, screenshots, or implementation details. The listing in the parent awesome-list adds that it is on the App Store and offers a leveled single-player mode.
use_cases: casual game to pass time on a Mac
notable: Leveled computer bots of increasing difficulty
Local multiplayer on a single Mac
Native macOS app written in Swift with Cocoa
caveats: README is minimal and gives no build or installation instructions
Online multiplayer details are not described in the README
